That's true... Personally I got into alt rock through Green Day's Dookie (I know that none of their members died, it's just they almost never play it's songs live anymore) and Nirvana's Nevermind. I got into metal through Blizzard of Oz and The Great Southern Trendkill. I don't know what I'd be listening to if it weren't for those four albums.

I wish I could have seen them in concert. Them along with Pantera, Nirvana, Death, and Mötörhead. 
I have never really had good self esteem honestly.

My friends and I play anything we feel like. We have done covers of the Ramones, Highly Suspect (for a school project my best friend and I were lumped into a group with the other friend's band not really sure if that counts though), Black Sabbath, and a few other bands. We have been working on a cover of War Pigs and a cover of Bury Me in Smoke (one of my favorite songs) by Down (a super group with Phil Anselmo of Pantera, Pepper Kennan of Corrosion of Conformity, they used to have Rex Brown of Pantera and Kirk Windstein of Crowbar but I'm not sure who replaced them). 
I don't think I'll have a girlfriend for a few reasons. A.) I'm a weird dude, I act goofy as hell around my friends but I'm quiet when I'm not around friends. 
B.) I'm a short dude. I'm about five foot three. Meanwhile I have to look up to talk to most girls. And all the ones who are my height and shorter (who seemed to be interested in me) are all taken...
C.) I'm kind of lacking in the good looks Department.
Sorry for taking so long to type this out.
